verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Twilio documents REST APIs and SDKs, offers an MCP server that indexes its API specs for coding agents, and provides a no-code console flow for sending a first SMS. None of this documents an interactive API reference with runnable, in-browser examples. These are adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
